# FrequencyIntegration

Source: [`Kernel/FrequencyIntegration.wl`](../../Kernel/FrequencyIntegration.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#frequencyintegration-kernelfrequencyintegrationwl--integratefrequencies)

IntegrateFrequencies: every projected integrand is a sum of monomials w^n Delta(w)^-a Delta(-w)^-b; each is integrated over the real w-axis exactly by residues (closing in the upper half plane, where the roots of Delta(w) lie), with a result rational in the coefficients c0, c1, c2 of Delta (no square roots). Generalises Iint/omegaIntegrate of DE4plus\_fast.wl. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "FrequencyIntegration".

## Symbols

### `IntegrateFrequencies`

`IntegrateFrequencies[projected]` integrates every projected integrand over w. Declared monomials are integrated symbolically (result in GammaAtom, DeltaCoefficient and dsR atoms); the others (Protected, DeclaredNumeric, Causality, Neglected) are evaluated exactly at random rational points of all atoms. Returns the "Integrated" stage.

### `FrequencyIntegral`

`FrequencyIntegral[n, a, b, deg]` = `Integrate[w^n / (Delta(w)^a Delta(-w)^b), {w, -Infinity, Infinity}]` with Delta(w) = C0 + C1 (I w) + C2 (I w)^2 (deg = 2) or C0 + C1 (I w) (deg = 1), all roots of Delta(w) in the upper half plane; rational in the coefficients `FrequencyIntegralC[0..2]`.

### `FrequencyIntegralC`

`FrequencyIntegralC[m]` is the coefficient c\_m of Delta in FrequencyIntegral results; `FrequencyIntegralC[j, m]` the coefficient c\_m of the Delta of pole family j in FrequencyIntegralFamilies results.

### `FrequencyIntegralFamilies`

`FrequencyIntegralFamilies[n, {{a1, b1, deg}, {a2, b2, deg}}]` = `Integrate[w^n / Prod_j (Delta_j(w)^aj Delta_j(-w)^bj), {w, -Infinity, Infinity}]` for two pole families Delta\_j(w) = sum\_m `FrequencyIntegralC[j, m]` (I w)^m (the propagator Delta at q and at Q = p + q, external frequency 0), all roots of each Delta\_j(w) in the upper half plane; rational in the coefficients (LO pipeline, design/LOPIPELINE.md step 4). A family {aj, bj, deg, "Shifted"} stands for Delta\_j(w + s\_j)^aj Delta\_j(-w - s\_j)^bj with the real shift s\_j = `FrequencyIntegralShift[j]` (the external frequency at Q, NLO pipeline, design/NLOPIPELINE.md N1); the result is rational in the coefficients and in s\_j.

### `FrequencyIntegralShift`

`FrequencyIntegralShift[j]` is the real frequency shift s\_j of a "Shifted" pole family j in FrequencyIntegralFamilies results: the family's factors are Delta\_j(w + s\_j) and Delta\_j(-w - s\_j) (design/NLOPIPELINE.md N1).

### `ShowFlow`

`ShowFlow[integrated, {a, b}, {m, n}]` prints the integrated flow of a monomial (symbolic, or its sampled values).
